sql.processStepStatus.availableForProcessSte: select cpsst.*, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.archived is not true and company_id = :companyId and not exists ( select id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst where pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id and pscpsst.archived is not true and pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId ) order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getCancelledTypesForCo: select cpsst.*, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.archived is not true and case when (:isParent and not :parentOverride) then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 3 order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getType: select cpsst.id, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, cpsst.archived, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on psst.id = cpsst.process_step_status_type_id where cpsst.id = :typeId
sql.processStepStatus.typeInUseByProject: select pps.id, pps.project_id, ps.process_step_name from flow.project_process_step pps inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id where pps.archived is not true and pps.company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId
sql.processStepStatus.typeInUse: select ps.process_step_name from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pscpsst.process_step_id where pscpsst.archived is not true and ps.archived is not true and pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId
sql.processStepStatus.deleteType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.updateType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set process_step_status_type = :processStepStatusType, process_step_status_type_id = :processStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.assignStatusToProcessS: insert into flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type(process_step_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, created_by_id, date_created, modified_by_id, date_modified) values (:processStepId, :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, :createdById, now(), :createdById, now())
sql.processStepStatus.updateAllowNonAdminUse: update flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type set allow_non_admin_use = :allowNonAdminUse, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.getProcessStepCompanyP: select pscpsst.*, ps.process_step_name, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.company_id, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, psst.process_step_status_type as root_process_step_status_type from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id where pscpsst.id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.deleteStatusFromProces: update flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.statusInUseByWQT: SELECT pswqtpsst.* FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps.id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type pswqt on ps.id = pswqt.process_step_id inner join flow.process_step_work_queue_type_process_step_status_type pswqtpsst on pswqt.id = pswqtpsst.process_step_work_queue_type_id and pswqtpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id WHERE pscpsst.id = :id and pscpsst.archived is not true and pswqtpsst.archived is not true and pswqt.archived is not true
sql.processStepStatus.statusInUseByInitialSt: select id from flow.process_step_process where process_step_id = :processStepId and initial_step is true and archived is not true and company_process_step_status_type_id = (select company_process_step_status_type_id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type where id = :id)
sql.processStepStatus.actionsUsingStatusToSe: select * from flow.process_step_action where process_step_id = :processStepId and company_process_step_status_type_id = (select company_process_step_status_type_id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type where id = :id) and archived is not true
sql.processStepStatus.childProcessesUsingSta: select psa.action_name, ps.process_step_name, psacp.* from flow.process_step_action_child_process psacp inner join flow.process_step_action psa on psacp.process_step_action_id = psa.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = psa.process_step_id where psacp.process_step_id = :processStepId and (psacp.initial_company_process_step_status_type_id = (select pscpsst1.company_process_step_status_type_id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst1 where pscpsst1.id = :id) or psacp.existing_company_process_step_status_type_id = (select pscpsst1.company_process_step_status_type_id from flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst1 where pscpsst1.id = :id)) and psacp.archived is not true and psa.archived is not true
sql.processStepStatus.getActiveAssignedToPro: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 1 and case when :nonAdmin::boolean is true then pscpsst.allow_non_admin_use = true else true end order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getAssignedToStep: SELECT distinct psst.id, psst.process_step_status_type FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true order by psst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getCompanyAssignedToSt: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, pscpsst.allow_non_admin_use, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getCancelledAssignedTo: SELECT cpsst.id, pscpsst.process_step_id as "processStepId", pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.archived, ps2.process_step_name as "processStepName", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cpsst.process_step_status_type_id as "processStepStatusTypeId", cpsst.company_id as "companyId", psst.process_step_status_type as "rootProcessStepStatusType" FROM flow.process_step_company_process_step_status_type pscpsst inner join flow.process_step ps2 on pscpsst.process_step_id = ps2.id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on pscpsst.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id inner join flow.process_step_status_type psst on cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = psst.id WHERE pscpsst.process_step_id = :processStepId AND pscpsst.archived is not true and cpsst.archived is not true AND cpsst.process_step_status_type_id = 3 and case when :nonAdmin::boolean is true then pscpsst.allow_non_admin_use = true else true end order by cpsst.process_step_status_type
